core_meaning.primary_meaning: Rehmat is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Mercy, compassion”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Rehmat corresponds to the Arabic form رَحْمَة (Arabic root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m); رَحْمَة (Raḥma)). Its core sense is rehmat; mercy, compassion. Rehmat is a spelling variant of Arabic رَحْمَة (Raḥma) 'mercy, compassion', from the root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m). The source gloss 'Mercy' is consistent. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source labelled the gender unisex; documented usage is predominantly male. Same name as rahmat.

persian.name: رحمت
persian.long_meaning: Rehmat (رحمت) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن رحمت، بخشش است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: रहमत

arabic.name: رَحْمَة
